subject: Application: Junior Estimator/Contract Administrator, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Junior Estimator and Contract Administrator advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and coursework in cost estimates and bills of quantities. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and materials, and keeping site and progress records. I live in Melton, close to Laverton North, and hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, with full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert mentions quantity take-offs from landscape and construction drawings and keeping supplier pricing and tender records, which builds on the bills of quantities from my course and the material records I kept on site. My estimating so far is from study rather than a paid role, so I would start at junior level and learn your price book.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short chat about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Application: Technical and Asset Officer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Technical and Asset Officer advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, carrying out inspections and quality checks and coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for regional work.

Your advert mentions quantities and cost estimates for minor works and managing Before You Dig enquiries, both of which I did in my course. I have not used survey instruments or GIS on a job yet, and I am open to discussing relocation to Cummins.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short call about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
